note: v0.20.0 finalization: every entry verified against official platform documentation on 2026-10-30. Platforms that publish no size (WhatsApp, some profile photos) are intentionally absent - no guessed numbers.

presets.name: Listing photo
presets.notes: Etsy recommends at least 2000 px on the shortest side at 72 PPI; the first listing photo needs at least 635 px. Shop Home shows a square crop.

presets.name: Cover image
presets.notes: Gumroad's rule of thumb: 1280 x 720 at least 72 DPI. Covers can be any shape; keep under 50 MB.

presets.name: Thumbnail
presets.notes: Shown in customer libraries, Gumroad Discover and your profile page. Gumroad says make it at least 600 x 600.

presets.name: Post (square)
presets.notes: Instagram keeps uploads between 320 and 1080 px wide as-is and downsizes anything larger; 1080 px wide is the sweet spot.

presets.name: Post (portrait)
presets.notes: The tallest feed format Instagram supports (4:5); more screen space for your design.

presets.name: Post (landscape)
presets.notes: The widest feed format Instagram supports (1.91:1).

presets.name: Story
presets.notes: Full-screen vertical. Keep text away from the very top and bottom so buttons do not cover it.

presets.name: Reel cover
presets.notes: Full-screen vertical, same shape as Stories.

presets.name: Cover photo
presets.notes: Facebook's recommended cover size (400 x 150 minimum). It crops differently on phones - keep the important part in the centre.

presets.name: Post / link image
presets.notes: Meta's sharing best practices: 1200 x 630 for the large render (600 x 315 minimum, 8 MB max).

presets.name: Pin
presets.notes: Pinterest recommends a 2:3 ratio (1000 x 1500); taller pins get cut off in feeds.

presets.name: Thumbnail
presets.notes: YouTube's recommended thumbnail resolution (minimum width 640 px, under 2 MB).

presets.name: Channel banner
presets.notes: Minimum upload dimension for the banner; keep text and logos inside the 1235 x 338 px safe area.

presets.name: Profile photo
presets.notes: Max 2 MB. Shown as a circle - keep the subject centred.

presets.name: Header
presets.notes: About 60 px at the top and bottom can crop on some screens - keep key content centred.
